filters.noResultsBody: Remove a filter or widen the distance to see more.

menu.matchesDesc: Picked from the skills on your profile

outcome.how: People from your own community reply first. Posting is free, and nobody pays a fee to apply.
outcome.free: Free to post. You choose whom to talk to.
outcome.noProfiles: No profiles yet for this. Post it, and people who do this work will reply.

hire-shop-staff.title: Hire staff for my shop
hire-shop-staff.short: Counter, sales, cleaning and security staff
hire-shop-staff.lead: Find counter and sales staff, helpers, cleaners and security guards who live near your shop, with the salary and timings you set.
hire-shop-staff.postBody: Say the role, salary and timings. People nearby apply or call you in the hours you choose.

home-repair.title: Get my home repaired
home-repair.short: Electricians, plumbers, carpenters, painters, AC repair
home-repair.lead: Electricians, plumbers, carpenters, painters and AC technicians near you — people your neighbours have already used.
home-repair.postBody: Say what is broken and when you are home. Nearby workers send you a quote.

build-website.title: Build my website
build-website.short: Developers and designers for your site
build-website.lead: Developers and designers who can make a website or app for your business, paid by milestone so you pay for what is done.
build-website.postBody: Describe the site and your budget. Compare proposals, then start a contract with milestones.

cater-event.title: Cater an event
cater-event.short: Caterers, cooks, cakes and event help
cater-event.lead: Caterers, cooks, bakers and event helpers for weddings, pujas and family functions, from your own community.
cater-event.postBody: Give the date, place and number of guests. Caterers reply with menus and prices.

gst-accounts.title: Do my GST and accounts
gst-accounts.short: GST filing, bookkeeping and income tax
gst-accounts.lead: Accountants and tax professionals for GST returns, monthly books and income tax — many offer fixed monthly packages.
gst-accounts.postBody: Say how many invoices a month and which returns. Compare packages and prices.

market-business.title: Market my business
market-business.short: Social media, content, design and photos
market-business.lead: Digital marketers, content writers, designers and photographers who can bring customers to your shop or brand.
market-business.postBody: Say what you sell and who your customers are. Freelancers send proposals.

trades.label: Browse by trade
trades.allHint: Pick one to see its opportunities.

state.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.

sparse.title: Want to see more work here?
sparse.body: Add your skills and we'll show work that fits you. Or post what you need, and people nearby will see it.
